title: ADD-RS
subtitle: Acute aortic syndrome risk categories
typeLabel: Risk stratification — suspected acute aortic syndrome
summary: ADD-RS counts high-risk condition, pain and examination categories in suspected acute aortic syndrome.
population: People with suspected acute aortic syndrome.

criteria.label: High-risk condition: Marfan or other connective-tissue disease, family history of aortic disease, known aortic valve disease, recent aortic manipulation, or known thoracic aortic aneurysm
High-risk pain: abrupt onset, severe intensity, or ripping/tearing quality
High-risk examination: pulse deficit or systolic BP differential, focal neurological deficit with pain, new aortic regurgitation murmur, or hypotension/shock

results.label: No risk category identified
interpretation: Acute aortic syndrome is not excluded when clinical suspicion persists.

results.label: One risk category
interpretation: Follow an acute aortic syndrome investigation pathway.

results.label: Multiple risk categories
interpretation: Urgent emergency assessment and definitive imaging are required.

overrides: Do not delay emergency conveyance or CT angiography where clinical concern remains.
limitations: This tool does not independently rule out dissection.
